narr: Clusters of showers and thunderstorms stalled over portions of southwest Alabama and trained over the same areas producing very heavy rain and flooding. The thunderstorms also produced strong winds which caused damage in southwest Alabama.
ev: Water covering several roads in the county with several road closures.
Willie Powell Road flooded near the intersection of Highway 162.
Water covering the road along CR29.
Flooding on Butler Drive near the intersection of Highway 43 and Highway 5.
Flooding on Chapel Hill Road from Toxey to Wimberly.
